description.value: Lil Chef Bistro is a European-inspired scratch kitchen in Squamish, serving house-cured meats, handmade schnitzel, fresh-rolled spätzle, and brunch dishes that have earned a loyal local following. Positioned along the Sea to Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler, it draws both travellers and regulars seeking old-world comfort food made entirely in-house. The adjacent deli offers house-roasted meats, housemade rosemary focaccia, and freshly made sandwiches — a practical stop for cyclists looking to refuel or stock up.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM name, address, and phone number. The FAQs page explicitly confirms vegetarian and gluten-friendly options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears anywhere on the site. A discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (Fr-Sa 00:00-24:00, i.e. 24 hours) and the website (Fri & Sat 9am-9pm), so the OSM hours appear incorrect.
concerns: OSM opening hours for Friday-Saturday show '00:00-24:00' (24 hours), which conflicts with the website listing Fri & Sat as 9am-9pm. OSM hours appear incorrect and should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating bistro and deli on the Sea to Sky corridor with a current website and confirmed contact details. Valuable stop for touring cyclists travelling between Vancouver and Whistler.

Packed lunches.detail: Deli makes fresh sandwiches daily on housemade rosemary focaccia with house-roasted meats and spreads — packaged food suitable for cyclists to take on the road

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'Yes - we have a lovely selection of vegetarian dishes and a range of gluten-friendly options. We're not a fully gluten-free kitchen, but we take dietary needs seriously.'

wow_evidence: adjacent deli offers house-roasted meats, housemade rosemary focaccia, and freshly made sandwiches
